selection_rule: Before test: highest strict dev Evidence Hit@3, then Hit@1, then fewer chunks, then alphabetic strategy. Human grounding remains a separate audit, not a tuning signal.

C.chunking: identical chunks and vectors to B
C.filter: chapter only when provided by question

coherence_sampling: Midpoint of first 10 sorted selected excerpt pages, all chunks covering each position. Per-position mean then overall mean.
limitations: A-B changes boundary policy, maximum length and overlap together; identifies overall chunking-strategy impact, not the isolated effect of sentence boundaries.
20 questions authored with AI assistance; human validation required. Dev/test share chapters and concepts; test is not independent by topic.
Exact evidence containment is a conservative automatic score; valid paraphrases and alternative source evidence need explicit human adjudication.
C reuses B embeddings; its ingest time excludes embedding compute. Compare shared B+C embedding cost transparently.
